import pandas as pd, glob, os
ap=pd.read_csv('airports.csv').set_index('airport')
rows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
    carrier=os.path.basename(f)[:2]
    d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
    utc='sched_dep_utc' in d.columns
    datecol='date_utc' if utc else 'date'; sc='sched_dep_utc' if utc else 'sched_dep'; ac='actual_dep_utc' if utc else 'actual_dep'
    raw=(pd.to_timedelta(d[ac].fillna(d[sc])+':00')-pd.to_timedelta(d[sc]+':00')).dt.total_seconds()/60
    delay=raw.where(raw>=-60, raw+1440)
    if utc:
        schedutc=pd.to_datetime(d['date_utc']+' '+d[sc])
        localdate=(schedutc+pd.to_timedelta(d.origin.map(ap.utc_offset_hours),unit='h')).dt.date
    else: localdate=pd.to_datetime(d.date).dt.date
    d['localdate']=localdate; d['delay']=delay
    feb=d[(pd.to_datetime(d.localdate).dt.year==2025)&(pd.to_datetime(d.localdate).dt.month==2)]
    completed=feb[~feb.cancelled]
    delayed=(completed.delay>15).sum()
    rows.append((carrier,len(feb),len(completed),delayed,delayed/len(completed)*100 if len(completed) else None, completed.delay.min(),completed.delay.max()))
print(pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['carrier','feb rows','completed','delayed','rate','min delay','max delay']).sort_values('carrier').to_string(index=False))

events.notes: Computed February 2025 rates from deduplicated flight_id records, excluding cancelled flights from both numerator and denominator. Applied the >15-minute delay rule and handled after-midnight departures; AS date/time fields were converted from UTC to the origin airport's local date using airports.csv.
